She wears a matching light-pink ribbed-knit loungewear set: long-sleeved cropped zip hoodie partially unzipped and matching ribbed pants. She has stacked gold rings on the left hand and a charm bracelet with silver and pink charms on the left wrist. Do not reproduce Sadie Sink or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Use a high-angle front-facing smartphone selfie.
